start.reminders.deniedNote: Notifications are blocked for Forge in iOS Settings. You can allow them there whenever you like.

tour.home.title: Today at a glance
tour.home.body: Today's session, how recovered you are and your day's progress. The profile button opens Settings.
tour.workout.title: Train in a tap
tour.workout.body: Start your session and log each set with one tap. The bolt button starts a quick workout.
tour.exercises.title: 500 animated exercises
tour.exercises.body: Search, filter and watch every movement. Swap any exercise if the machine is taken.
tour.nutrition.title: Log what you eat
tour.nutrition.body: Search foods, scan a barcode or repeat a meal. Your targets follow your goal.
tour.progress.title: See how you're doing
